The '''LRRL-75 rocket launcher''' was a type of [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Corso Riggs]] owned a LRRL-75, which he named [[Bitsy (rocket launcher)|Bitsy]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Czerka Arms LRRL-75 rocket launcher was first mentioned in Corso Riggs's entry in the [[2012]] reference guide, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
